text:
ellen_finance: Heads-up: Helion Labs (private) renewal HL-2024-501 looks mis-billed. Contract SOW shows Platform Fee 9% + Standard Support, but invoiced at 16% + Advanced Support.
toby_am: yikes. How big is it?
ellen_finance: Quick pull from ledger:

```
Billed lines:
1) OnPrem License - Enterprise - $200,000
2) Platform Fee (16%) - $32,000
3) Support (Advanced) - $36,000

Contract/SOW expected:
2) Platform Fee (9%) - $18,000
3) Support (Standard) - $18,000
```

ellen_finance: Delta = platform $14,000 + support $18,000 = $32,000 pre-tax. Invoice was auto-issued and paid.
sara_ops: Any chance customer accepted an upgrade during renewal? Ops notes show no add-on requests. Renewal import script BILL-2041 had a mapping change last week.
toby_am: spoke w/ AM, customer says they did not agree to Advanced. They want a credit applied + confirmation in their portal.
ellen_finance: billing_bot, preview credit memo for $32,000 and show resulting balance impact.
billing_bot: CREDIT PREVIEW -> Account: HELION-LABS | Total Credit: $32,000 | Tax: TBD | Apply to next invoice or refund ACH. Current outstanding: $1,250. If apply to next invoice -> balance after apply = -$30,750 credit. Reply `apply_credit` or `refund_ach`.
toby_am: Helion prefers credit applied. I'll confirm in email.
ellen_finance: Note approval matrix: credits > $25k require VP Finance sign-off. Routing for approval + remediation plan. Also need settlement acknowledgement per legal.
vp_finance: Reviewing. Please include short remediation steps and confirm revenue impact (RevRec).
ellen_finance: Remediation: 1) Block the recent mapping change in BILL-2041 (done) 2) Run a migration audit for last 90 days to surface similar mismatches (ticket ONB-820) 3) Add validation to renewal import to assert SOW line-items match invoice SKUs. RevRec: we'll reverse recognized revenue tied to mis-billed lines and post AJEs.
legal_bot: Recommend settlement acknowledgement email w/ one-line release to avoid chargebacks. We'll prepare template.
vp_finance: Approved pending settlement ack. Approve credit memo $32,000 to be applied to next invoice. Record approval note: "VP Finance 1829999999 approved credit for Helion Labs due to renewal mapping error; require settlement ack."
ellen_finance: Creating credit memo CM-2024-300 and applying to account. Adding audit notes to HL-2024-501.
billing_bot: CREDIT MEMO CREATED -> CM-2024-300 | Amount: $32,000 | Apply: next invoice | Status: pending customer ack.
toby_am: Customer confirmed acceptance of credit and signed settlement email. They also asked for a one-time waiver of late fees on last year's invoices; ok to grant?
vp_finance: Waiver of late fees under $2k is fine. Approve.
ellen_finance: Applied waiver and updated ledger. CM applied; portal shows -$30,750 credit after ledger taxes.
sara_ops: ONB-820 created and scope expanded to include a full rollback test for renewal imports. ETA 3 business days.
toby_am: Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick fix. Please let us know when the import validation is in place." :thumbsup:
ellen_finance: Closing thread; will follow up when ONB-820 completes and RevRec posts AJEs.
